ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 75% low-intensity (black) to 25% high-intensity (white) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Left lobe: Large, high-intensity geometric blob in the upper right quadrant, bisected by a vertical dark line. Right lobe: Diffuse high-intensity region in the upper outer quadrant characterized by radial, feathered striations extending toward the lateral margin.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a calculated vertex angle of approximately 65 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations along the posterior boundary; pixel-amplitude variations range from 2 to 6 pixels, with the highest density of peaks located on the distal thirds of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edges exhibit a linear to slightly concave sweep from the median notch to the lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distinct cluster of roughly circular high-intensity pixel groups (barnacles) localized on the far lateral tip of the left lobe; secondary cluster of high-intensity nodules visible at the insertion point of the fluke and peduncle on the left side.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A single, prominent vertical low-intensity linear stroke bisecting the primary high-intensity patch on the left lobe; multiple thin, high-intensity vertical rake marks visible on the inner margin of the right lobe's white patch.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization on the distal tip of the left lobe causing an irregular, protrusive boundary; cluster of parasitic or barnacle lesions at the fluke base.
other_distinctive_markers: The internal texture of the right lobe's pigmentation exhibits a unique radial 'spray' pattern of high-intensity pixels against the black background, contrasting with the more solid pigmentation of the left lobe.
